faq.q: Can I hire a marketing agency without a long contract in the UK?
faq.a: Yes. Look for rolling monthly plans with 30 days' notice or less and no exit fees.

faq.q: What is a normal agency contract length?
faq.a: Many UK agencies ask for 6 to 12 months, especially for SEO.

faq.q: Does ContentFellow have a minimum term?
faq.a: No long contract. Plans are monthly, from £59 a month.

faq.q: Do I keep my accounts if I leave an agency?
faq.a: You should. Make sure the contract says you own your accounts, website, domain and content.
